blocks.text: Acid Lab — v1.0.39
{{DATE}}
New
New app icon — updated to the hexagon logo.
Panic button — stops all audio instantly. Click the red button in the transport bar or press Ctrl+.
Keyboard shortcuts panel — press ? anywhere to see all shortcuts.
Window position memory — app windows remember where you left them.
Undo / Redo for knobs — Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undoes and redoes knob changes.
QOL
Knob double-click resets to default value. Right-click to type a precise value.
Knob scroll: hold Shift for fine adjustment (÷5), Ctrl for coarse (×5).
Value pill — current value shown in a floating pill while dragging any knob.
Arrow key control — click a knob then use ↑↓ to adjust. Shift+arrow for fine.
Zoom shortcuts — Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 to zoom the workspace.
Ctrl+Shift+W closes all open windows. / key focuses app library search.
Middle-click a dock icon to spawn a new instance.
Unfocused windows dim to 85% opacity — focused window always stands out.
Bug Fixes
Step Sequencer — SWING knob now has effect. Odd steps are delayed by the correct amount.
Animation loops in Tape, Sidechain, Glitch, Osc Bank, and Freq Shift no longer run after the window is closed.
Previous — v1.0.38
Multi-band Compressor, Glitch, Distortion and Update Checker bug fixes. macOS build added.
